core_control_semantics.<|bos|>: beginning of a token sequence / document boundary
core_control_semantics.<|eos|>: end of a token sequence / document boundary
core_control_semantics.<|pad|>: right-padding filler; never carries content; masked in loss
core_control_semantics.<|tool_call|>: opens a tool invocation emitted by the assistant
core_control_semantics.<|tool_result|>: opens a successful tool result supplied to the model
core_control_semantics.<|tool_error|>: opens a failed tool result / error supplied to the model
core_control_semantics.<|observation|>: opens an environment observation supplied to the model
core_control_semantics.<|action|>: opens an action record in an autonomous-control trace
core_control_semantics.<|final|>: marks the assistant's final answer segment
